course_name_original: Competências transversais: aquisição automatizada de dados laboratoriais
course_name_en: Transversal competences: automated laboratory data acquisition

learning_outcomes.text: Identify the relevant characteristics of a measurement device
Indentify the relevant characteristics of an analog/digital conversion system
Properly connect measurement devices to analog/digital conversion systems

syllabus_topics: Creation of a data acquisition program
Implementation of data reading and storage
Creation of a serial RS-232 communication program
teaching_methods: Laboratory practice in a computer room
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.6 times the practical work grade plus 0.4 times the test grade. A maximum of 25% absence is allowed according to FEUP's regulations. Classification improvement can be achieved through a practical exam with 100% weight.
bibliography: Park, J., Mackay, S.; Practical data acquisition for instrumentation and control systems . ISBN: 9780750657969
Ehsani, B.; Data Acquisition Using LabVIEW. ISBN: 9781782172161
